basic_info.description: Situated on a deep/wide lot on a prime tree-lined block in Pacific Heights half a block from Fillmore Street and between Alta Plaza & Lafayette Parks, this remodeled home retains stunning period details complemented by modern flair. The main level boasts soaring ceilings & grand scale w/ expansive living room w/ fireplace, built-in media center & oversized windows. The dining room features a fireplace + deck/yard access. Adjacent to the dining room is a great room & eat-in chef's kitchen w/ high-end appliances, marble counters & family area w/ walk-out deck. Up the skylit staircase are 4 bedrooms, featuring the incredible primary suite w/ 2 walk-in closets, en-suite bath, & fireplace. A 2nd suite w/ marble bath & play/homework area plus 2 add'l bedrooms & full bath are the perfect layout. The lower level family room has access to the stunning S-facing yard + full bath, office/5th bedroom & interior access to a 3-car garage w/ storage. This caliber of a property is a true forever home.
